svg.text: Scaffolded models hide the sensitive feature from LIME and SHAP
Share of test points where an uncorrelated synthetic feature is ranked as the top explanation after the attack. Before it, the
sensitive feature (race, gender, loan rate) was top-1.
Innocuous feature ranked first (% of points)
